tasks.title: Announcement #33
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university gym.
tasks.transcript: Man: Attention, the fitness center will be closing in two minutes. Please wrap up your workouts. Remember to return all dumbbells, bars and other items to their proper places. As a reminder, we will be closed for our cleanup day tomorrow, but we hope to see you again when we reopen on Saturday morning, the day after tomorrow. Have a good night and a safe trip home.

questions.stem: What are visitors asked to do?

options.A: Clean any items they have used
options.C: Prepare for a workout in two minutes
options.D: Put exercise equipment in the correct locations

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：访客被要求做什么？属于细节理解题。 定位原文：Man: Please wrap up your workouts. Remember to return all dumbbells, bars and other items to their proper places. 选项分析： A. Clean any items they have used 清洁他们使用过的任何物品。因为通知只要求归还物品到原位，并未提及清洁，所以 A 选项错误。 B. Renew their fitness center membership 续办健身中心会员资格。因为通知中未提及会员续费事宜，所以 B 选项错误。 C. Prepare for a workout in two minutes 在两分钟内准备锻炼。因为通知说是两分钟后关门，要求结束锻炼，而不是准备开始，所以 C 选项错误。 D. Put exercise equipment in the correct locations 把健身器材放到正确的位置。由于男士明确要求将哑铃、杠铃等物品归还到原位，所以 D 选项正确。

options.A: The fitness center will be closed.
options.B: The fitness center will hire additional employees.
options.C: The dumbbells in the fitness center will be replaced.
options.D: A new morning class will begin at the fitness center.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：关于明天提到了什么？属于细节理解题。 定位原文：Man: As a reminder, we will be closed for our cleanup day tomorrow... 选项分析： A. The fitness center will be closed. 健身中心将关闭。因为男士明确说明天是清洁日，健身中心将关闭，所以 A 选项正确。 B. The fitness center will hire additional employees. 健身中心将雇佣额外员工。因为通知中未提及招聘事宜，所以 B 选项错误。 C. The dumbbells in the fitness center will be replaced. 健身中心的哑铃将被更换。因为通知只提到清洁，未提及更换设备，所以 C 选项错误。 D. A new morning class will begin at the fitness center. 健身中心将开始新的晨练课程。因为通知中未提及新课程，所以 D 选项错误。
